NBEMS Group A, B & C Various Post Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : National Board of Examination (NBE) has released the admit card for the Group A, B & C Various post Exam 2026. Applications for the NBEMS Group A, B & C Various Post Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 07 July 2026, to 20 July 2026. The Examination is going to conducted on 05-06 September 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their NBEMS Group A, B & C Various Post Admit Card from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 07 July 2026
  • Last Date : 31 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 31 July 2026
  • Exam Date : 15-16 September 2026 Revised
  • Admit Card : 11 September 2026
  • Result Available : Will be Updated Here Soon

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 1500/- (+18% GST Extra)
  • SC, ST, PH & Female : Rs. 00/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
